hero.subhead: TruthLens is a browser extension and dashboard that asks an AI model (Google Gemini) to look for signs that text, images, video or a webpage were machine-made. You get a quick estimate with the reasons behind it: a second opinion, not proof.

dashboard.title: Run a scan.
dashboard.subtitle: Paste text, drop an image or video, or analyze a URL. TruthLens returns an AI-assisted estimate in seconds.
dashboard.drop_image_hint: Drop a PNG / JPEG / WebP, or browse
dashboard.drop_video_hint: Drop MP4 / MOV / WebM, or browse
dashboard.url_disclaimer: Public pages only · We strip scripts and analyze the visible text body.

verdict.scanning_sub: Asking the AI model to look for signs of machine generation…
verdict.disclaimer: AI-assisted estimate from Google Gemini, a general AI model, not a trained deepfake detector. Treat it as a hint, not proof.

settings.label: // SETTINGS
settings.title: Configure your TruthLens.
settings.subtitle: Paste a webhook URL — we'll POST a JSON alert when a DEEPFAKE is detected. Slack, Discord, Make, Zapier and any HTTPS endpoint that accepts JSON will work.

how.label: // PROTOCOL
how.step1_body: Paste text, drop an image or video, or feed a URL. The browser extension lets you scan in-place on any webpage.
how.step2_body: Sent to Google Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash) with a prompt asking it to look for the tell-tale signs below. It's a general AI model, not a purpose-trained detector.
how.step3_body: Things like anatomical errors, odd lighting, repetitive phrasing, each tagged by severity so you can judge for yourself.
how.step4_body: A 0–100 estimate with a label: HUMAN, AI, DEEPFAKE or UNCERTAIN. A starting point, not a final answer.

extension.label: // CHROME EXTENSION · v1.0
extension.subtitle: Right-click any image or selected text on the web and TruthLens shows the AI's estimate right on the page. Works on news sites, social platforms, anywhere.

login.label: // ACCOUNT
login.subtitle: Email magic-link login is coming soon. For now your history is stored on this device.
